title: US console sales fall 39% and physical games hit historic low
summary: Spending on consoles and physical games plummets in July as average price rises to $542 due to memory costs.

title: Take-Two subpoenas Microsoft over GTA 6 leaks and a hacker threatens to release the game on PC
summary: The publisher seeks Discord user identities following daily gameplay leaks, while an extortionist pressures Rockstar.

title: AMD reaches record market share against Intel in consumer, desktop, and servers
summary: Desktop CPU shipments fall 20%, but AMD achieves historic highs of 34.9% in desktop and 34.5% in servers.

title: RayNeo unveils its camera-less AR glasses iO and GT, focused on text overlays
summary: The company launches two augmented reality glasses models that forgo a camera to prioritize notifications and visual translation.
